name: Barbell Hip Thrust
cues: Rest your upper back on the bench edge just below your shoulder blades
Pad the bar and roll it into your hip crease
Set your feet so your shins are vertical at the top
Tuck your chin and keep your ribs down
Lock out with your glutes, not by arching your lower back
